Home.statusBody: The shared shell, theme and language support are working. Hardware and other pages will follow in later steps.

About.intro: LobbyTwoZero (LTZ) is being built as a game-focused social platform. It aims to be a hub where players discover and discuss games, make friends and find teammates to play with.
About.statusBody: This page describes the project's goals; not all of the features below are live yet. Ready sections will be announced as they are published.

discover.title: Game discovery
discover.body: Browse the game catalog, rate games and write reviews.

social.title: Social interaction
social.body: Make friends, send messages and find players to play with.

community.title: Community
community.body: Come together with the player community through posts and events.

performance.title: Hardware and performance
performance.body: Describe your PC hardware, see game performance experiences and get recommendations.

Faq.intro: Short answers to the most basic questions about the project. The project is under development; answers will be updated as it progresses.

what.a: A game-focused social platform that aims to bring together game discovery, the player community and social interaction with hardware and game performance experiences.

ready.q: What can I use right now?
ready.a: Right now only the basic interface (theme, language, navigation) is ready. Accounts, the game catalog, social features and hardware sections are not live yet.

hardware.q: What will the hardware and performance feature do?
hardware.a: The goal is for players to describe their PC hardware, see game performance experiences and get suitable recommendations. This section is not ready yet.

data.q: How will my personal data be handled?
data.a: The privacy notice, privacy policy and cookie policy have not been published yet. They will be prepared before account and data collection features are opened.

Contact.intro: There is no published contact channel right now.
Contact.bodyTitle: The official support address has not been decided yet
Contact.body: The official email address and contact form for feedback and support will be published on this page once they are decided. No address shown on this page should be treated as an official contact channel unless it has been verified.
